critique: The note proves the advertised target-span iff, including solution independence and a full-observed-law positive-SCM converse; Zhang Proposition 2.3 only establishes constancy over an abstract bridge-solution fiber, while Rahiminasab Theorem 3 gives a sufficient predictive result under full quotient-level source rank. The inference contribution is substantially weaker than the identification result: the Hoeffding projection set has coverage but may be empty off the coverage event or equal all of [0,1], with no diameter, power, or weak-rank efficiency guarantee. The adaptation impossibility applies only to the deliberately unrestricted changing-rank array class and does not establish optimality of the proposed projection set on informative subclasses. Off the target span, the note proves local nonidentification rather than sharp identified-set endpoints, so the framing is accurate as an identification frontier but not a sharp partial-identification or inference frontier.
